metadata.database: A Deeper China | Hangzhou point decision layer

HZ001.guest_value: Clarify whether the visitor wants lake, gardens, walking, photography or recovery.
HZ001.choose_rule: Use before drawing a full West Lake route.
HZ001.stop_after: One lake question and physical mode are clear.

HZ002.guest_value: Change time and route shape instead of adding more West Lake points.
HZ002.choose_rule: Use morning/evening based on heat, crowds and guest mood.

HZ003.guest_value: Connect tea place, labour, hills and taste.
HZ003.choose_rule: Choose only if tea landscape is the question, not just buying.
HZ003.stop_after: One tea landscape/labour relationship is clear.

HZ004.guest_value: Separate tea learning from purchasing and provenance claims.
HZ004.choose_rule: Buying remains independent; no quality, price or seller guarantee.
HZ004.stop_after: The visitor knows what they are buying and what cannot be verified.

HZ005.guest_value: Offer an indoor tea/cultural frame for weather or lower-load days.
HZ005.choose_rule: Choose by current exhibition/programme and guest learning question.
HZ005.stop_after: One tea history/culture idea is understood.

HZ006.guest_value: Help the visitor decide whether Buddhist art, worship or mountain atmosphere is the draw.
HZ006.choose_rule: Use one sacred route and explain etiquette before entry/photography.
HZ006.stop_after: The visitor has a respectful, specific reason for the visit.

HZ007.guest_value: Keep worship and visitors’ behaviour from becoming a spectacle.
HZ007.choose_rule: Consent, temple rules and quiet behaviour override the photo goal.
HZ007.stop_after: The visitor can participate respectfully or chooses not to enter.

HZ008.guest_value: Use Southern Song memory and water-city history to deepen Hangzhou beyond scenery.
HZ008.choose_rule: Choose history, commerce or urban memory—not another scenic loop.

HZ009.guest_value: Make Hefang a conscious commercial/history choice.
HZ009.choose_rule: Use only if retail energy or recognisable street history fits.
HZ009.stop_after: The visitor decides the commercial layer serves the brief.

HZ010.guest_value: Offer canal/urban water life as an alternative to a crowded lake day.
HZ010.choose_rule: Choose only when the visitor wants infrastructure, commerce or water-city history.

HZ011.guest_value: Preserve landscape and quiet when West Lake is crowded or weather-poor.
HZ011.choose_rule: Use as one recovery/landscape branch, not an extra park checklist.
HZ011.stop_after: The visitor has recovered and retained a nature question.

HZ012.guest_value: Keep the day workable through heat, rain and lower energy.
HZ012.choose_rule: Hold as an uncommitted alternative until current opening and weather rules are known.
HZ012.stop_after: The visitor has recovered without losing the day’s question.

HZ013.guest_value: Offer a present-day Hangzhou layer for repeat visitors.
HZ013.choose_rule: Choose only when current programme/public access answers a real urban or digital-life question.

HZ014.guest_value: Make Shanghai–Hangzhou timing and purpose explicit.
HZ014.choose_rule: Use only when one anchor survives the same-day return.
HZ014.stop_after: The visitor has a rail/last-mile plan and one chosen Hangzhou question.

HZ015.guest_value: Show when one night materially improves West Lake/tea/recovery pacing.
HZ015.choose_rule: Recommend overnight when a day trip cannot carry the intended question.
HZ015.stop_after: The visitor accepts the hotel and transfer cost.

HZ016.guest_value: Compare Shanghai, Hangzhou and Suzhou by distinct questions rather than adding all three.
HZ016.choose_rule: Require minimum nights and a clear contrast before adding Suzhou.
HZ016.stop_after: The sequence and transfer cost are accepted.

HZ017.guest_value: Protect arrival, payment and local movement from consuming the day.
HZ017.choose_rule: Build from station, hotel, luggage, payment and start time.
HZ017.stop_after: The visitor can reach the chosen anchor with buffer.

HZ018.guest_value: Make hills, stairs, heat and last-mile movement visible before route selection.
HZ018.choose_rule: Use to remove or shorten tea/temple/lake branches when needed.
HZ018.stop_after: The visitor has a credible accessible-enough route or a clear no-go.

HZ019.guest_value: Give a one-day Hangzhou structure with one anchor and one recovery option.
HZ019.choose_rule: Use one West Lake/tea/history question only; do not promise a full city.
HZ019.stop_after: The guest has a realistic train and return buffer.

HZ020.guest_value: Use four days for lake, tea, history and one contemporary/recovery layer.
HZ020.choose_rule: Add a new question per day; do not repeat scenic loops.
HZ020.stop_after: Each day has a distinct theme and protected recovery.
